title: Concept: Dependency installed over SSH from a git remote
description: package.json declares a dependency installed from a git remote over SSH, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The install trusts whatever host key and account the build machine has, so the code that runs is decided outside the registry and outside the lockfile hash.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The install trusts whatever host key and account the build machine has, so the code that runs is decided outside the registry and outside the lockfile hash.
